title: Jenkins job coq-jev-herdr-plugin: lint/lint.sh on every push to main in ghcr.io/jkkelley/coq-lint:1 (amd64+arm64), from the Jenkinsfile
text: Owner 2026-10-10 UTC: nothing by hand. Kubernetes agent pod on the arm64 homelab cluster, imagePullPolicy Always, imagePullSecret ghcr-pull-secret, triggers githubPush and pollSCM H/10. Build 3 green 20:07 UTC. make lint-image-push rebuilds and pushes the image.
